acceptanceRule: All three fixed final cold observations must meet each unchanged proposed gate; no best-of selection. Profiling-only observations are excluded.

source.normalization: SHA256 of text source with CRLF normalized to LF; binary files use exact bytes; raw SHA256 retained per file
source.implementation: Billing/checkout schemas validate lazily after successful HTTP responses, fenced by session epoch. Validator-load failure gives readable503 reload guidance; schema validation remains mandatory. AppShell/Post were restored to exact HEAD bytes. Gallery, authentication, store, messaging, CSS, design and feature gates are unchanged.

setup.cache: new browser/context per observation; CDP cache disabled
setup.delivery: local static server, gzip level5 for eligible bodies >=1024 bytes; not Nginx/container acceptance
setup.api: strict synthetic authenticated feed; no production data/accounts/provider calls
setup.externalHosts: DNS blocked except loopback; fonts/media/provider delivery excluded
setup.sourceBuild: corepack pnpm9.15.4; production env and synthetic public-beta/operator fixture values from playwright.config.ts; private hidden source maps and visualizer for diagnostics only

host.clockCaveat: CIM-reported diagnostic, not continuous frequency telemetry
host.context: No owned build or measurement browser active during these counter samples. Unrelated user processes were not stopped or altered. Host variation prevents an accepted timing-causality claim.

payloadChange.gzipCaveat: Estimated gzip compresses every loaded JS body. Actual delivery leaves bodies below1024 bytes uncompressed; HTTP headers are excluded from encodedBodySize.
